name: What types of glass can be used for replacement insulated glass units?

mainEntity.name: What types of glass can be used for replacement insulated glass units?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacement insulated glass units (IGUs) can incorporate various types of glass to meet specific needs. Options include standard clear glass, Low-E (low-emissivity) coatings for enhanced energy efficiency, tempered safety glass for increased strength, obscure or privacy glass, and different tints. You can also choose inert gas fills like argon or krypton to further improve insulation. Your contractor can recommend the best glass type based on your home's requirements and climate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options for replacement glass units include clear, Low-E, tempered, obscure, and tinted glass, often with inert gas fills.
